public static String addThousandSeparator(int n) {
    String result = n + "";
    if (n < 0) {
        result = "-" + result;
    }
    int length = result.length();
    for (int i = length - 4; i > 0; i -= 3) {
        result = result.substring(0, i) + "." + result.substring(i);
    }
    return result;
}

This code generates a function named `addThousandSeparator` that takes an integer `n` as input and adds a dot (.) as a thousand separator every three digits in the resulting string. The returned string is either the input number with the thousand separators added or the input number with a negation symbol (-) if the number is negative.
